summary: Verified the Distributor Withdrawal Blocked bug fix end-to-end. 14/14 pytest cases passed exercising: distributor /stats new field `available_for_withdrawal`, agent vs distributor branching in POST /api/withdrawals, distributor 400 with 'Insufficient earnings balance' (never 'wallet'), admin approve drops earnings everywhere (distributor /stats + admin /users row), admin reject releases the pending reservation without touching earnings, agent regression (wallet debits immediately, unchanged on approve). 9/9 Playwright UI assertions confirmed the SAME ₹70.00 live earnings appear in all four UX surfaces: Distributor Overview KPI, Withdrawal page 'AVAILABLE EARNINGS' chip, Admin Distributors table EARNINGS column, Admin View modal Earnings card. Toast on over-withdraw renders 'Insufficient earnings balance. Available: ₹70.00'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1927 lines — still well over the 700-line guideline. Withdrawals + recharges + distributor stats should live in their own routers.

GET /api/admin/users/{uid} does NOT include the live `earnings` value; only the list endpoint does. The 'View' modal in _UserList.jsx currently works only because it reuses the row prop from /admin/users. If a future refactor switches the modal to call /admin/users/{uid}, the Earnings card will silently fall back to ₹0 (`distributor.earnings ?? 0`). Recommend adding `earnings` to the detail endpoint for symmetry.
Distributor withdrawal reject path (server.py:922-924) is correct — flips status only, no wallet ledger entry, so available_for_withdrawal naturally restores via re-aggregation. Verified.
Approve path re-checks live balance (server.py:896-903) and refuses if insufficient at approval-time — good defensive double-check.
get_distributor_available_for_withdrawal subtracts both 'approved' and 'pending' from lifetime so a distributor cannot double-spend; verified via the chip decreasing on pending creation.

rca of the issue: Original bug: POST /api/withdrawals always called adjust_balance(user_id, -amount) on the wallets collection. For distributors wallets.balance is always 0 because distributors do not transact — their earnings live on the recharges collection via the immutable `distributor_earnings_amount` snapshot. The fix branches by role: distributors validate against `get_distributor_available_for_withdrawal = lifetime − approved − pending`; agents keep wallet adjust_balance. Approve/Reject branches similarly skip the wallet ledger for distributor role. Frontend _Withdrawal.jsx now picks the source (distributor /stats vs /wallet) using useAuth().user.role. All four earnings render points (Overview KPI, Withdrawal chip, Admin table col, Admin modal card) read from the same `_distributor_earnings_for` / `_distributor_earnings_batch` helpers, ensuring perfect sync.
